markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if a qualifying definitive agreement is officially confirmed.
markets.rules_primary: If Jeanie Buss and/or any trust or legal entity holding her ownership interest in the Los Angeles L Pro Basketball team executes or enters into a definitive, legally binding agreement to sell all remaining ownership interests attributable to Jeanie Buss in the Los Angeles L Pro Basketball team after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying action is an officially confirmed execution of or entry into a definitive agreement. Closing may occur after the deadline. Negotiations, letters of intent, drafts, rumors, and unexecuted or conditional announcements do not count. A transfer solely to an affiliate or entity controlled by the named holder does not count unless the specified beneficial ownership interest is sold to an unaffiliated buyer.
